BiblicalUsage: The word is a weight, and it appears once, in the sign of the siege: Ezekiel's bread was weighed out at twenty shekels a day, eaten from time to time, while he lay on his side for the iniquity of the house.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that weighed bread is the picture of siege: when God measures the food, the city knows it is under judgment.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
